## Review Pulse – 6 Live page (public, read-only)
Serves the latest **published** pulse + explainer and the status of every week, straight from the runs tab.

• Publish this workflow, then open the **Production URL** of the Webhook node.
• `?week=2026-W40` shows an older week.
• Read-only: it cannot start runs, see the Doc/Gmail links or send anything.
